[b]We are very excited to announce that Good Night, Knight is now available in Early Access! [/b]

A dynamic sneak-and-slash RPG that mixes procedural generation with hand-made scenarios and a darkly humorous story. [h1]Good Night, Knight is now 20% OFF![/h1]

Of course, it’s just the beginning of the adventure. Even though Good Night, Knight is already packed with features, we have new areas and challenges planned for players. Today we're revealing our roadmap with an overview of some of the planned major updates!

notes.title: Game Mechanics (Part 3)
notes.notes:
[h1]Let's talk about the game’s mechanics, part 3[/h1]

The phase of escaping and hiding from demons is crucial because it gives you an idea of what these bastards see and hear. But then you think: maybe I should be stealthy from the beginning and remain unseen. Congratulations, you just discovered another layer of Apparition's gameplay.

So, next time when you hear footsteps or just have a gut feeling that a demon will appear in a moment, you go away from light sources, crouch in the bushes, hide your candle and wait. And here it is - a demon majestically walking among the trees, for the first time unaware of your presence.

Finally, you can take out your photo or video camera and record the daemon, earning more and more points with every second. Feels good, right? Now, your next task is to decide, when to hide the camera and retreat to the car before your protagonist loses sanity or something kills him.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/782e2fb654c13a6d89ef322f4d0d1874ae63bf3e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Mechanics (Part 2)
notes.notes:
[h1]Let's talk about the game’s mechanics,[/h1]

You already know that your activity in the Green Creek forest, and getting the first points, provokes a demon's appearance. You also know that a close encounter with those apparitions ends with swift death. Now your challenge is to survive longer. So, by instinct, you try to flee and hide.

You probably look for a shelter in the cabin, maybe even get into the closet. Or you hide behind one of the sheds so that the demon will lose sight of you. While hiding in the darkness, it comes to your mind that standing with a candle in the open isn't the best idea. You're getting smarter, good for you.

You also discover that none of these tactics is bulletproof. That's Apparition alright - you can never feel safe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/84d55862c87d79ddfd63940df6157ca606973cfa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Mechanics (Part 1)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/9915cc0ffc04c717b7216a944ccb2f754c2f5f78.png[/img]

[h1][b]Let's talk about the game’s mechanics,[/b][/h1]

Apparition isn’t your typical game, showing you the mechanics first, then telling you: go, explore a series of levels. Here, things are turned around: there is one location - the forest of Green Creek - it’s immediately available, and it’s the mechanics that await discovery. Specifically, how to summon a demon from the woods and survive an encounter with it.

The primary objective of Apparition is gathering points which you receive for photographing and filming evidence of the disturbing history of Green Creek, ghosts, and demons. That, and surviving, of course, if you want to keep your points, you will have to make it back to your car and drive away to safety.

In the first layer of gameplay, you die quickly and often. You return to the forest of Green Creek to try again and maybe live a little longer. You come to the forest at night, earning your first points by filming or photographing disturbing things in and around the cabin. You speak to spirits using the Ouija board and… you hear footsteps in the woods. A demon. By the time you see it, it’s already running at you, and your end is swift. The demons cannot be fought; you can make a desperate attempt at running, or remain unseen.

Perhaps you will find some way to outwit the demon on your next visit.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/b4a3594573f6a192796b452e2a77cee1dcb63f0a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Layers of Dread #3 – Crafting Half of Your Life
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/bb1f1035ca1d20cfcb4a615c6d8fa6cf0995dd91.jpg[/img]

The crowbar. The crowbar is the answer to some lingering questions. It has been shown that, in case of invasion, when the crowbar is delivered with precision to the face of an angry monster from another dimension, it can bring some much needed relief to our mind. But we're not here to discuss the advantages of a free mind, but to make your investigation more efficient and successful.

[b]Okay, so you’ve gathered some sweet experience points. Now it's time to check out the store’s shelves before going back to the land of wickedness. [/b]Remember that crowbar I mentioned earlier? You're going to need it. Trust me. Invest in this handsome skull-opening bad boy and hop into your car. We're heading to Green Creek again!

I don't know if you’ve noticed, but there is a [b]closed cellar[/b] in one of the shacks you checked before. Let's try to pry the door open with our trusty friend – Mr. Crowbar. 

Okay, so we are inside the cellar. [b]We have a crafting table and a few metal scraps laying here and there.[/b] I guess we could try to search for some more useful parts while exploring Green Creek. You're a bright guy. Maybe you can figure out how to make some traps to mess with the demons and make our stay here a little less miserable and terrifying? 

I believe in you. Stay alive.

And in the meantime please check out [i]Appartion's[/i] [url=http://apparitiongame.com/] website [/url] to stay up to date with any important information!

notes.title: Layers of Dread #2 – Buy your happiness
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/d677053dad9bc0d56cf55413d62ff016f1499793.jpg[/img]

Holy crap, I can't believe you actually managed to escape that abomination. I told you that you really need to be careful while talking to those demonic bastards, didn't I? Man, don't apologize, just be more careful next time or you may end up haunting this place with the rest of them!

I mentioned the experience points earlier, but we didn't have time to get deeper into that matter while we were being chased. Anyway, all the evidence of the paranormal activities which you’ve gathered throughout your stay at Green Creek are awarded points. [b]The experience points collected during the gameplay are crucial in achieving success in [i]Apparition.[/i][/b] In fact, they serve as a kind of currency in the local stores. Buying new equipment will allow you to document apparitions more efficiently and will open up new, unexplored places in Green Creek. Every visit to this haunted and forsaken place makes for a new adventure... if you can call being chased by hellish creatures and barely escaping with your life an adventure.

Want to know more, do you? Let's talk more about it next time. Be sure to check out the game's [url=http://apparitiongame.com] website [/url] to stay up to date with any further announcements.

notes.title: Layers of Dread #1 - You died!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/79a653da67756540586dd07d8336fcbe71e9ea0b.jpg[/img]

Of course you did. [i]Apparition[/i] is a survival horror exploration game and it has got quite a rogue-like vibe to it. That means that [b]you’re gonna repeat your visits to Green Creek a LOT[/b]. Many visits will involve gruesome deaths, such as one you've just experienced. Deal with it, adapt and improvise!

Your main goal in [i]Apparition[/i] is to gather experience points by documenting all the paranormal activities occurring near Green Creek. [b]Every photograph and video recording is awarded abstract and meaningful numbers. You thought I'd say they were meaningless? WRONG![/b] That's a very important game mechanic. Wanna know why? Come back next week and I'll give you the run down in the next announcement. 

Now, we've got a more important matter at hand - a friggin' ghost is chasing after you! You should've been nicer to him when you were chatting to him on the Ouija board. Just sayin’. [b]The trickiest part of the gameplay is to get the hell out of that cursed place with all your earned experience[/b]. Death means losing the points that you've just gathered during this particular visit, so staying alive is totally worth it as it will save you from repeating the same tasks over and over.

The more experience you gather, the more the secrets of Green Creek will be revealed before your very eyes. But that’s a topic for another story. Be sure to add [i]Apparition[/i] to your wishlist to stay up to date with all the important announcements!

notes.title: The cel shaded dread of Green Creek
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/bc3795033f73a0393858551e9f2a560547d72136.jpg[/img]

Welcome again, dear Investigator.

I have summoned you here because I found another one of those arcane tomes that document the ways of The Great One, The Developer, Mr. Ciastku. This particular volume sheds some more light on the creation of Green Creek.

You've probably noticed, Mr. Investigator, how when you enter this haunted place everything around you starts to look a bit... different? The world begins to shift as one crosses the border from our reality into the one designed by The Developer. [b]This is due to the forbidden magic flowing through space and time which makes all visible matter seem blue-ish or even comic book-like.[/b] Thick outlines appear around objects and bodies. One could say it seems cel shaded and kind of... charming?

The tome says also that Mr. Ciastku was inspired visually by the works of other Great Ones. The works called [i]Wick[/i] and [i]Unforgiving[/i] were the most influential.

Stay strong, Mr. Investigator, as the colorful look of Green Creek can be deceiving. Under The Developer’s spell, it’s easy to forget about the demons and ghosts lurking around every corner. Waiting...

For more info please add [i]Apparition[/i] to your wishlist as I am willing to provide you with any necessary information about The Great One and his ways.

notes.title: The mages of sound
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/2c24360a8d0d0a39752871cf4b7e93c1e97266ee.jpg[/img]

Mr. Investigator! How great to see that you are still alive. Your brave and bold heart refuses to stay away from Green Creek, where demons and the otherworldly roam at night. As I’ve mentioned before, I'm in awe of your determination and I'm willing to help you. What brings you to me today, my dear?

[b]Aah, the sounds. I know. That's how the ancient magic of the Great One works.[/b] Sometimes, between the ambiance of the night and the noises of the dead, one can hear something you could call music. However, I must warn you my dear. It's all in your head and no one else can hear it besides you – as you are the one currently under The Developer's spell.

Once upon a time, while conceiving this wicked place called Green Creek, the Great One summoned two musical mages to help him build the atmosphere of this horrid landscape. Thus, [url=https://soundcloud.com/isserleyishome] Isserley the Sad One [/url] and [url=https://soundcloud.com/myuu] Myuu the Dark Sound Composer [/url] aided him, as they were fascinated by Mr. Ciastku's creations. notes.title: The Bloody Mary you don't want to drink
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/163c5cfc4a78de457c749fd34389cc68ebfe060e.png[/img]

Welcome, dear Mr. Investigator. I see you are still persistent in studying the ways of the Great One. Don't worry, I won't try to talk you out of it anymore. I'm just an old lady. How can I resist your unbridled courage? I'm willing to help you out, now that I’ve got to know you a little better. But bear in mind, bold sir, that the consequences of this knowledge can be grim for your mental health.

Do you like a good drink, Mr. Investigator? Have you ever had a Bloody Mary? You may be not aware, but its name is taken straight from the world behind the looking glass. There was once a human ritual which encouraged young woman to walk up stairs backwards while holding a candle in one hand and a mirror in the other. It is said that by doing so, they could see a glimpse of their future husband's face in the reflection. Alas, sometimes the woman saw the face of death in the mirror, and have died in the process, before they could ever meet their future love.

Bloody Mary herself had shared this fate and now, [b]when you chant her name three times while looking into the mirror, she appears as a corpse or a ghost[/b]. She can be benign, but she can also be very deadly and seen covered in blood. Many humans who have tried to contact her ended up strangled or even soulless.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/a8b8b6c42e55f9fda59a04c4b4103feb24ef1e66.jpg[/img]

[b]The haunting of castles, buildings and huge manors has always been a topic of fascination for mankind[/b]. You can find creepy villas, possessed houses and mansions full of specters, ghosts and the undead in many legends and tales of horror throughout the ages. Ah, of course, brave investigator, coming from the land of man, you are familiar with moving pictures and it's these records, converted from well-known chronicles, which have served to influence the Developer in his creations.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/f64aea612afa5125b8c1731085790f34fec8b2c2.jpg[/img]
Green Creek  holds many deep, dark secrets. Our goal in Apparition is to bear witness and document any abnormal, paranormal or ghostly activities. We enter the haunted forest armed with an Ouija board – the forbidden, mystical tool which is said to enable one to speak with the dead. 

Let's think about it as a wooden phone reaching out and connecting us to the deceased and otherworldly. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/7a9158a810950e1ae2d30a0cef3fedf5c5fabc74.jpg[/img]

The Ouija board lets us ask about whatever we're trying to figure out at the moment.  For example, if we're feeling lost, we can ask the dead, "Where am I?" If the particular spirit we have contacted doesn't come up with a satisfying answer, we can always say "Goodbye" and try to contact another. Perhaps the next one will prove himself more helpful in our investigation.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/22800a130ef9be333fc7e62d55e0153ea9172919.jpg[/img]

But beware! Communicating with the dead can be extremely dangerous. Ghosts are volatile entities and depending on our answers, ghosts can change their attitude towards you, which will have direct impact on the paranormal activities occuring around us. The more spirits get angry, the more spectral apparitions we‘ll see, and the anger intensifies other weird happenings as well.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/f94f148653cd996fc03fe82021d029439e7f38ec.gif[/img]
[i]Getting attacked by an invisible force after using the board[/i]

Annoying the spirits can become a useful tactic from a researcher's point of view, but for starters let's try to remember to always greet them with politeness.


Do you like this idea? Great! Please add Apparition to your wishlist, so you can stay up to date with any announcements about our game!

notes.title: Who you gonna call?
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/f64aea612afa5125b8c1731085790f34fec8b2c2.jpg[/img]
Green Creek  holds many deep, dark secrets. Our goal in Apparition is to bear witness and document any abnormal, paranormal or ghostly activities. We enter the haunted forest armed with an Ouija board – the forbidden, mystical tool which is said to enable one to speak with the dead. 

Let's think about it as a wooden phone reaching out and connecting us to the deceased and otherworldly. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/7a9158a810950e1ae2d30a0cef3fedf5c5fabc74.jpg[/img]

The Ouija board lets us ask about whatever we're trying to figure out at the moment.  For example, if we're feeling lost, we can ask the dead, "Where am I?" If the particular spirit we have contacted doesn't come up with a satisfying answer, we can always say "Goodbye" and try to contact another. Perhaps the next one will prove himself more helpful in our investigation.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/22800a130ef9be333fc7e62d55e0153ea9172919.jpg[/img]

But beware! Communicating with the dead can be extremely dangerous. Ghosts are volatile entities and depending on our answers, ghosts can change their attitude towards you, which will have direct impact on the paranormal activities occuring around us. The more spirits get angry, the more spectral apparitions we‘ll see, and the anger intensifies other weird happenings as well.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194220/f94f148653cd996fc03fe82021d029439e7f38ec.gif[/img]
[i]Getting attacked by an invisible force after using the board[/i]

Annoying the spirits can become a useful tactic from a researcher's point of view, but for starters let's try to remember to always greet them with politeness.


Do you like this idea? Great! Please add Apparition to your wishlist, so you can stay up to date with any announcements about our game!
